entries.title: Search and filter accessible inventory
entries.neutral_requirement: Search names, native categories and visible state across admitted roots; show the real source and explain excluded roots.
entries.evidence: Project owner correction on 2026-10-18: inventory search and filtering are vanilla. Exact current full-text-search binding was not independently established by this source check.
entries.implementation_origin: Independent design required; external code/assets/text import NONE
entries.decision: Do not replace or duplicate native inventory search/filtering. An extension requires a separately reproduced vanilla limitation and a new review.
entries.source_check: Installed ISInventoryPane.lua contains onFilterMenu and weight ordering. That observation alone is not proof of the full-text search UI; no such proof is claimed.

limited_vanilla_source_evidence.claim: Native inventory filter menu with weight ordering is present. Full-text-search binding NOT ESTABLISHED by this observation.
